# Vendored third-party assets

| Directory | Component | Licence | File |
|---|---|---|---|
| `katex/` | KaTeX (math typesetting, CSS/JS/fonts) | MIT | `katex/LICENSE` |
| `fonts/` | Plus Jakarta Sans (Latin, Latin-ext woff2 subsets) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `fonts/OFL.txt` |

KaTeX version: see the banner of `katex/katex.min.js`. The fonts are the Fontsource
redistribution of the upstream Plus Jakarta Sans family (Tokotype). Both licences allow
embedding in generated PDFs; the licence texts must stay with any redistribution of these directories.
